summary: EShallgo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-16 share consolidation approved by the board on April 10, 2026, effective April 20, 2026. The consolidation reduces Class A shares from ~26.51M to ~1.66M and Class B from ~5.86M to ~0.37M, with no fractional shares issued. Par value increases to $0.0016 per share. The action is intended to maintain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). No fractional shares are issued; rounding is up. This is a routine corporate action to meet listing standards, not a special situation.
